higher_loads_reason: Score every entry at the requested first target, then measure the interval between 310,000 and 350,000. higher_load_continuation_reason: After the first passing 350,000-user hold on the current build, repeat that count with the stock search duration and the full hold. Then test 370,000 and 400,000 independently on the same larger-table fixture. Retain the declared five-peer comparison and every failed or ineligible attempt.

published_capacity_anchors.reason: Measure the selected large-table fixture against published capacities for all five peers, plus the earlier C submission at its official passing and failing points. Keep all ties and failed controls when interpreting local capacity.

after_mixed_350k_holds.reason: The shipping binary passed one of two full 350,000-user holds while passing its independent two-minute probe. Measure 345,000 with two fresh full holds and a stock probe to bracket a repeatable boundary. Keep both 350,000-user outcomes in the capacity estimate.

kensac_330k_followup.reason: Kensac passed a separate same-binary 310,000-user calibration and missed the 330,000-user full hold with every connection open. Test 325,000 users with both stock durations, preserving existing order. This count is 20,000 below the 345,000-user C bracket.

pavlyhalim_330k_followup.reason: Pavlyhalim passed at 310,000 and missed at 330,000 with 9.67 s p99 and exactly 330,000 dials. Test the same two intermediate loads and both stock durations used for Mojo. Repeat the five-minute hold at 325,000, which is 20,000 below the C bracket at 345,000.

remaining_325k_peers.reason: The current build passed two 345,000-user holds and its stock probe.
